name: shinsekai-1912-provisional-topology
description: Historical relationships and one approximate first-tower anchor. Null geometry is intentional until the CC0 1912 survey map is georeferenced and the 1913 facility plan is traced; do not render these as surveyed locations.
coordinateSystem: WGS84 for the modern control point only
